title: Ukraine and Romania sign a strategic partnership declaration in Bucharest
body:
On 12 March 2026, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Romanian President Nicusor Dan signed a strategic partnership declaration in Bucharest. The leaders agreed to expand cooperation in energy and defense.

Dan said the two countries would jointly produce drones. Russian attack drones have repeatedly crashed on Romanian territory during the war. Ukraine was also building two new power supply lines with Romania to strengthen energy security in border regions, including Chernivtsi Oblast. The sides discussed importing American liquefied natural gas into Ukraine and jointly developing Ukrainian gas fields.

Zelensky was also scheduled to visit a training centre, opened in 2023, where Ukrainian pilots learn to fly Western-supplied F-16 fighter jets. Romania is a NATO member and has given Ukraine military aid, backed sanctions against Russia and signed a bilateral security agreement with Kyiv. Dan won the 2025 presidential election against a candidate widely seen as sceptical of Ukraine and has since taken a supportive stance toward Kyiv.
